def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs.get('n', 146)
    k = inputs.get('k', 4)
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position
    # Simulate the elimination process
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    pos = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Remove every k-th person (k-1 because of 0-indexing)
        pos = (pos + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(pos)
        # After removal, pos is already at the next person to start counting from
    
    return float(people[0])
